comments.author: @Top10Documentary999
comments.text: 97% overweight is shocking, but is it really fair to blame the people of Nauru? 🤔 How much of this is personal choice, and how much is caused by isolation, imported food, and the country’s limited resources? What do you think?

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: I agree — it’s not just personal choice. Isolation, imported food, limited fresh options, and economic factors all play a huge role.
